What we do. And how we do it.

Core Service

Site documentation for construction teams and project managers.

Our standard visit covers everything a project team needs to make decisions on a space — from pre-lease diligence to pre-construction capture to renovation documentation. We align on your brief before we arrive, follow a disciplined capture route on site, and deliver a structured package within three to five business days.

The deliverable is always the same architecture: digital twin, narrated walkthrough, conditions report, equipment schedule where relevant, labeled photo storyboard, and ScopeWalk platform access. Consistent enough to compare across sites. Detailed enough to brief your consultants directly.

Full detail on construction and commercial documentation →

Rollout Programmes

The same standard. Across every site in your programme.

For operators running rollout programmes — retail, healthcare, hospitality, franchise — consistency is the deliverable. Every site produces the same structured package through ScopeWalk, in the same format, accessible in the same place. Your design team briefs from the same information on site one as they do on site fifty.

We coordinate access and travel nationally, with programme pricing that includes travel costs rather than adding them per visit.

Multi-site and rollout documentation →

Specialist Work

Some projects require a different kind of attention.

Beyond our core commercial work, we take on projects where the brief is specific, the environment is significant, or the standard approach won't do. We've documented spaces that required specialist access techniques, precision equipment, and a level of discretion that most survey operators aren't equipped to offer.

If your project is unusual — in its location, its complexity, or what it requires of the people doing the work — we'd like to hear about it.

How it works.

01

Clarify the brief

We align on what you're deciding, what your team needs to see, and what the deliverable needs to do before anyone travels anywhere.

02

Coordinate access

We handle building management, security coordination, and travel logistics. National travel model means no surprises on costs.

03

Capture the site

On site we follow a disciplined route documented through ScopeWalk in real time — structure, services, equipment, conditions, access. Nothing missed.

04

Deliver and access

Digital twin, report, walkthrough, and schedule delivered within three to five business days and permanently accessible through ScopeWalk.
